SFCertificatePresentation.doc: An object that displays a certificate sheet for a provided certificate trust.

-initWithTrust:.doc: Initialize the certificate presentation with a certificate trust reference.

helpURL.doc: The URL that will be opened by clicking the “Learn More” button.

message.doc: Message string to be displayed. If no message is provided, a default message will be used.

title.doc: Title string to be displayed. If no title is provided, a default title will be used.

trust.doc: A trust reference, previously created with SecTrustCreateWithCertificates (see <Security/SecTrust.h>).
